Alicia (PM): Quick sync — legal pushed back on evidence volume for SOC2. They want clarity: do we require full indexing of audit logs at launch or can we ship with sampled/indexed evidence + a full export path?
Marco (Security): Short answer: sampled indexing + export is acceptable if we document sampling strategy and retention guarantees. But SOC2 auditor asked specifically about ability to produce ‘all relevant logs’ on request.
Priya (SRE): From infra side, full indexing of 1TB/day is $$$ and increases query latency for live dashboards. We can do a hot-sample + cold-archive export. Hot = recent 30d indexed, cold = S3 with integrity tags.
Dan (Sales): Customers asking for an "evidence-first" SLA for enterprise pilots. They expect searchability for investigations. If we say "sampled" they'll escalate. Need a comercialable line.
Alicia (PM): Proposal: Launch with 30d indexed (searchable), 1y cold-archive with on-demand full export within 72h, and an optional add-on for full indexing + extended retention. Can we cost that? @Priya @Marco
Marco (Security): That maps to controls: index = evidence readily available, archive+export = complete chain-of-custody. We'll need signed hashes for archived bundles and KMS-wrapped manifests for proofs.
Priya (SRE): Rough numbers:
```
Assumptions:
- Raw logs ingested: 1TB/day (~30TB/mo)
- Indexing cost (compute+storage): $0.25 per GB/mo
- Archive storage (S3-like): $0.02 per GB/mo

Full indexing cost ~ 30TB * $250/ TB = $7,500/mo (hot index)
Sampled (30d hot, 10% sample) ~ $750/mo
Cold archive for 1y ~ 365TB * $20/TB = $7,300/yr
```
Priya (SRE): Note: numbers are rough. Full indexing increases op complexity (sharding, retention compactions).
Dan (Sales): If we position sampled+export as "meets SOC2 evidence requirements with export SLA", customers will accept if export SLA is tight and audit artifacts are cryptographically verifiable. Pricing add-on for full indexing is fine.
Alicia (PM): Decision needed: Acceptable default launch plan or must we prioritize full indexing for pilot customers? Options: 1) Sampled+export default, add-on full index; 2) Full index for all enterprise tenants at launch (higher cost, slower launch).
Marco (Security): For SOC2 scoping, option 1 is defensible if we:
- Publish sampling methodology
- Provide proof-of-archive (hashes + KMS-wrapped manifests)
- Commit to export SLA (<=72h) + audit playbook

Priya (SRE): Ops notes for option 1: need an export orchestration runbook, integrity verification step, and a per-tenant throttle to avoid blast radius during exports. Implementation risk: medium.
Dan (Sales): I'll flag to top customers that export SLA will be contractual for pilots. That should mitigate churn risk.
Alicia (PM): Ok propose we go with option 1 for GA and add a roadmap item: "Full-index paid tier" with target Q3. Action items: @Marco flesh out required proof artifacts and playbook, @Priya estimate infra work + runbook, @Dan list customers who need full index at launch. I'll collate and set decision by EOD Friday. :calendar: :spiral_calendar: 
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket PRODUCT-8492 for "evidence export orchestration"
Marco (Security): noted. I'll draft the proof template and minimal auditor-facing docs by Thursday.
Priya (SRE): I'll attach a first-pass cost model and runbook stub to PRODUCT-8492 by Thursday midday.
Dan (Sales): I'll DM the list to Alicia and copy in legal for contract language.
Alicia (PM): Great, thanks team. We'll aim for sampled+export GA with paid full-index tier. Closing thread after FRIDAY decision. :white_check_mark:
